tools.name: publish_to_aster
tools.title: Publish to Aster
tools.description: Publish a self-contained HTML artifact (such as a Claude design or artifact) as a shareable Aster web page. Returns a public share URL and an admin URL for managing or deleting the page. Links expire 30 days after creation. The HTML must be a complete standalone document.

artifact_html.description: The full, self-contained HTML document of the artifact to publish.

title.description: Optional title shown on the share page. Defaults to 'Untitled link'.
